verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page names customizable fields and workflows, with global and project-level configuration, and a community user confirms it offers a good amount of customization. The evidence is marketing-level and does not detail how statuses are defined or managed. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on creating custom fields and editing workflow statuses/transitions, explicit mention of custom statuses, hands-on corroboration specific to field/workflow configuration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Scale processes and save time with customizable workflows that integrate with your tech stack.
It offers a good amount of customization too
